concepts.name: 01-faculty-at-work
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: custom editorial illustration concept for the faculty dashboard greeting banner of EquipED, an institutional learning-material review application at Laguna State Polytechnic University Santa Cruz Campus. This is illustration artwork only, NOT a website screenshot, mockup, logo, or concept board. Style: refined contemporary 2D vector-like editorial illustration, crisp simple silhouettes and clean edges, few well-composed overlapping shapes providing gentle dimensionality; mature academic character, calm and welcoming. Palette: royal blue #1b3b87, dark royal blue #142f70, light blue #e8eef9, paper white #fbfcfc, ink #1b2b33, blue-grey #cad6da, with very restrained amber #d9ad1d accents. For skin only use warm natural neutral tones. Wide horizontal composition approximately 2:1, clear at a displayed width of 350px, all subjects completely inside frame with comfortable transparent margins. Background must be genuinely transparent. No lettering, labels, text, numbers, logos, UI cards, scores, charts, approval stamps, watermarks, gradients, 3D rendering, photorealism, noisy texture, decorative confetti, random floating icons or generic blobs. Keep details sparse and purposeful. Subject: one adult Filipino faculty member seated in a composed three-quarter view at a simple desk reviewing an open learning module with a pen. An elegant royal-blue overshirt, understated facial features, natural hands and relaxed thoughtful posture. Foreground paper has just two or three abstract content lines. A small stack of reference pages and a slim amber bookmark support the scene. Strong person-and-desk silhouette, a little overlap of paper and chair, warm human focal point. Avoid exaggerated cartoon proportions and oversized heads.
